contract.title: Product Owner Git Decision Ingress and Visible Acceptance Status
prohibited_actions: Do not bypass ProductOwnerConfirmationService or ProductOwnerDecisionConsumer
Do not infer Product Owner authority from chat text task files branch presence commit message or unsigned free-form Git content
Do not write DONE directly and do not weaken WAITING_FOR_PRODUCT_OWNER fail-closed behavior
Do not accept a decision without exact binding to one live approval context nonce task product commit Architect PASS lifecycle version operation and repository identity
Do not weaken replay protection idempotency authorization expiry stale-context rejection or append-only decision journals
Do not expose authentication proofs nonces secrets tokens prompts or raw command arguments in logs or status projection
Do not create a generic remote command execution channel
Do not mutate product source files as part of transport ingestion except through the existing Product Owner lifecycle projection after successful authenticated consumption
Do not change risk scoring product features Executive UI Risk Manager UI or TASK-0132
Do not remove existing Architect Git ingress or autonomous Architect review behavior
acceptance_criteria: Add an explicit Git-backed Product Owner decision ingress using only the dedicated remote branch aidp/product-owner-decisions and one exact immutable JSON ingress directory under .ai/orchestration/product-owner-decisions.
The ingress is transport only and must feed the existing ApprovalContextIssuer ProductOwnerConfirmationService and ProductOwnerDecisionConsumer boundaries rather than changing lifecycle state itself.

A remote decision is accepted only after a fresh local ApprovalChallenge exists and the remote command binds its exact approval_context_id nonce task id operation product commit and Architect review identity.

Authentication and authorization remain independently verified fail-closed boundaries; Git transport metadata alone is insufficient unless an explicit verified and allowlisted repository identity adapter validates it.

Implement one concrete repository identity adapter suitable for the configured GitHub repository that verifies the authoritative origin repository and an allowlisted Product Owner identity or app-backed provenance before producing AuthenticatedProductOwner and ProductOwnerAuthorizationEvidence.

Malformed duplicated mutated nested stale expired replayed unauthorized wrong-task wrong-commit wrong-review wrong-repository wrong-operation or nonce-mismatched commands are rejected and never consumed.
The watcher polls Product Owner ingress while the product lane is WAITING_FOR_PRODUCT_OWNER without blocking the independent infrastructure lane.

After a valid ACCEPT command the existing ProductOwnerDecisionConsumer alone projects TASK-0131 or any later product task to DONE and pushes the product branch; REQUEST_REWORK continues to project PRODUCT_OWNER_REWORK_REQUESTED.

Status projection visibly distinguishes PO_CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED PO_DECISION_RECEIVED PO_DECISION_CONSUMING DONE BLOCKED and HUMAN_ACTION_REQUIRED and includes task id last progress timestamp blocker category and watcher health without sensitive data.
Start-AIDPVisibleWatcher displays concise live lane status and heartbeat changes so the operator can see whether Product Architect Codex or Product Owner is currently the blocking actor.

The implementation includes a safe one-time deployment or self-update path for the authoritative orchestration-execution checkout so an approved infrastructure implementation can become the runtime used by the scheduled watcher without manual copy-paste and without dirty-worktree overwrite.
Deployment fails closed if the orchestration-execution checkout is dirty diverged or not on the expected branch and never resets cleans stashes or force-updates it.
Positive E2E proves Git command publication to remote ingress through authenticated confirmation persistence consumption lifecycle projection push and visible status with no manual file copying.

Adversarial tests prove repository substitution author spoofing unsigned or unverifiable commit provenance stale context replay nonce reuse command mutation duplicate command and expired challenge all fail closed.
Full orchestration tests and git diff --check pass before Architect review.
